description_en: Updates a dynamic parameter for a specific cluster and service
description_zh: 用于更新指定集群、服务下的单个动态参数的值
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-config --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --config-type service --name my-llm-service --config-key rate_limit --value 200 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateConfig

parameters.help_en: The cluster or region ID. This parameter is required. For example, `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.help_zh: 集群/地域 ID（必填），例如 `cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration type. This parameter is required. Currently, only `service` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 配置类型（必填），目前仅支持 `service`
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The service name. This parameter is required
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The dynamic parameter name. This parameter is required
parameters.name: config_key

parameters.help_en: The new dynamic parameter value. This parameter is required
parameters.name: value

CreatedAt.description_en: The time the configuration was created

UpdatedAt.description_en: The time the configuration was last updated

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. This parameter is required
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The cluster or region ID. This parameter is required. For example, `cn-hangzhou`

v1_parameters.name: ConfigType
